Details
  • Paper: Falconsai/nsfw_image_detection, Model card, 2023-10-13
  • Original code: https://huggingface.co/Falconsai/nsfw_image_detection at 96cb0d0342c7
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files:
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/Falconsai/nsfw_image_detection/blob/96cb0d0342c7afb80cab76ecc58b265fa44da256/README.md
  • Training data: ImageNet-21k / ImageNet-22k (full ImageNet, fall 2011 release), Falconsai proprietary NSFW data (about 80 000 images, normal / nsfw)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, fvm_conv, fvm_extra, fvm_mb, fvm_r3
  • Variants: falconsai-nsfw-vit
  • Outputs: logits; label_set: nsfw-2
  • Input size: fixed 224x224: the input is resized (short side 224) and centre-cropped to it
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): falconsai-nsfw-vit 224x224 (0.2 GiB peak allocated, 0.3 reserved)
  • falconsai-nsfw-vit 224x224, first call: TensorRT fp16 27 s (ONNX + engine).
  • falconsai-nsfw-vit original 224x224: .half() on 1 modules, fp16 inputs
  • falconsai-nsfw-vit load / first call: original 2.95 s / 0.273 s, portable 2.63 s / 0.094 s, kernels 2.42 s / 0.085 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 1e-05 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.009 and p99 <= 0.011 (absolute error of the output logits).

Limitations

  • The image is stretched to 224 x 224 without keeping its aspect ratio, as the original processor does.
